title: Northgate Tire Center Late-Settlement Allowance on Treadwear Credits
content:
# Late-settlement allowance on treadwear credits

**Commitment.** When a Northgate Tire Center treadwear credit is booked long after the claim visit, a late-settlement allowance is added to the credit. The allowance is read from the calendar days from the service date of the claim entry (the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package) to the day the credit is booked:

| Calendar days from the claim entry to the day the credit is booked | Late-settlement allowance |
|---|---|
| more than 180 | $10.00 |
| more than 90 and at most 180 | $5.00 |
| 90 or fewer | $0 — no allowance |

**How the allowance acts.** The allowance is a dollar amount added to the treadwear credit. It is added to the prorated treadwear amount once that amount has been fully worked out, it is never itself prorated or multiplied, and the sum is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary days (hypothetical claim entry dated 2026-01-10)

| Credit booked on | Calendar days | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-10 | 90 | $0 |
| 2026-04-11 | 91 | $5.00 |
| 2026-07-09 | 180 | $5.00 |
| 2026-07-10 | 181 | $10.00 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A treadwear credit whose prorated treadwear amount is $31.40, booked 120 days after the claim entry, comes to $36.40.
